title: Keep generator documentation aligned with its contract
scope: Changes under tools/generators that alter an available generator name, invocation command, generated project layout, project identity, architecture tag, or documented output contract.
applies_when: The changed generator behavior is described by tools/generators/README.md before the pull request.
violation: The pull request changes the documented generator contract but leaves the canonical README claiming the previous command, name, layout, identity, tag, or behavior.
non_violation: An internal refactor that preserves the documented contract is not a violation, and a contract change is not a violation when the same pull request updates or removes every affected README claim.
evidence: Cite the changed generator behavior and the exact README claim that becomes false on the reviewed head.
